about: A version's text as it's encrypted (#60): MAGIC (NUL 'TZ' 1) then raw deflate of the UTF-8; none: the text as it is. One that names its writer (#505): NUL 'TZ' 2, then raw deflate of the writer's JSON (its length first, u32 big-endian) and the text; `writer`: who it says wrote it (none: it doesn't, or can't be read). web/core/history.js unpackVersion and plim-core version.rs unpack_version must both read each.
